item.description: Writing articles with citations in Word can be a real pain. item.title: Into the NDE: Debugging the Afterlife
item.description: NDE (Near-Death Experience) is basically what happens when your system uptime hits 99.9% and then suddenly crashes, only to reboot with unexpected admin privileges. Organizations like IANDS and researchers like Dr. P.M.H. Atwater have logged thousands of tickets (case studies) on this.
